lines.gurmukhi: ਕਲਿਜੁਗੁ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਆ ਪਗ ਤ੍ਰੈ ਖਿਸਕੀਆ ਪਗੁ ਚਉਥਾ ਟਿਕੈ ਟਿਕਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: kalijug har keeaa pag trai khisakeeaa pag chauthaa tikai tikaai jeeu ||
lines.translation: The Lord ushered in the Dark Age, the Iron Age of Kali Yuga; three legs of religion were lost, and only the fourth leg remained intact.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਸਬਦੁ ਕਮਾਇਆ ਅਉਖਧੁ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਪਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: gurasabad kamaaiaa aukhadh har paaiaa har keerat har saa(n)t paai jeeu ||
lines.translation: Acting in accordance with the Word of the Guru's Shabad, the medicine of the Lord's Name is obtained. Singing the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises, divine peace is obtained.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਰੁਤਿ ਆਈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਡਾਈ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਖੇਤੁ ਜਮਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: har keerat rut aaee har naam vadaaee har har naam khet jamaaiaa ||
lines.translation: The season of singing the Lord's Praise has arrived; the Lord's Name is glorified, and the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, grows in the field of the body.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਲਿਜੁਗਿ ਬੀਜੁ ਬੀਜੇ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਸਭੁ ਲਾਹਾ ਮੂਲੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: kalijug beej beeje bin naavai sabh laahaa mool gavaaiaa ||
lines.translation: In the Dark Age of Kali Yuga, if one plants any other seed than the Name, all profit and capital is lost.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਪਾਇਆ ਮਨਿ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਲਖਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: jan naanak gur pooraa paaiaa man hiradai naam lakhaai jeeu ||
lines.translation: Servant Nanak has found the Perfect Guru, who has revealed to him the Naam within his heart and mind.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਲਜੁਗੁ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਆ ਪਗ ਤ੍ਰੈ ਖਿਸਕੀਆ ਪਗੁ ਚਉਥਾ ਟਿਕੈ ਟਿਕਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੪॥੧੧॥
lines.transliteration: kalajug har keeaa pag trai khisakeeaa pag chauthaa tikai tikaai jeeu ||4||4||11||
lines.translation: The Lord ushered in the Dark Age, the Iron Age of Kali Yuga; three legs of religion were lost, and only the fourth leg remained intact. ||4||4||11||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
lines.transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 4 ||
lines.translation: Aasaa, Fourth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਈ ਪਰਮ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਈ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਮੀਠ ਲਗਾਨ ਜੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: har keerat man bhaaee param gat paaee har man tan meeth lagaan jeeu ||
lines.translation: One whose mind is pleased with the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises, attains the supreme status; the Lord seems so sweet to her mind and body.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਧੁਰਿ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਭਾਗ ਪੁਰਾਨ ਜੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: har har ras paaiaa guramat har dhiaaiaa dhur masatak bhaag puraan jeeu ||
lines.translation: She obtains the sublime essence of the Lord, Har, Har; through the Guru's Teachings, she meditates on the Lord, and the destiny written on her forehead is fulfilled.

lines.gurmukhi: ਧੁਰਿ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਭਾਗੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸੁਹਾਗੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੈ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: dhur masatak bhaag har naam suhaag har naamai har gun gaaiaa ||
lines.translation: By that high destiny written on her forehead, she chants the Name of the Lord, her Husband, and through the Name of the Lord, she sings the Lord's Glorious Praises.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਸਤਕਿ ਮਣੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਬਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਗਟੀ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੈ ਹਰਿ ਸੋਹਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: masatak manee preet bahu pragatee har naamai har sohaaiaa ||
lines.translation: The jewel of immense love sparkles on her forehead, and she is adorned with the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਿਲੀ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮਨੂਆ ਮਾਨ ਜੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: jotee jot milee prabh paaiaa mil satigur manooaa maan jeeu ||
lines.translation: Her light blends with the Supreme Light, and she obtains God; meeting the True Guru, her mind is satisfied.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਈ ਪਰਮ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਈ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਮੀਠ ਲਗਾਨ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: har keerat man bhaaee param gat paaee har man tan meeth lagaan jeeu ||1||
lines.translation: One whose mind is pleased with the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises, attains the supreme status; the Lord seems sweet to her mind and body. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਗਾਇਆ ਪਰਮ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਤੇ ਊਤਮ ਜਨ ਪਰਧਾਨ ਜੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: har har jas gaaiaa param pad paaiaa te ootam jan paradhaan jeeu ||
lines.translation: Those who sing the Praises of the Lord, Har, Har, obtain the supreme status; they are the most exalted and acclaimed people.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਨੑ ਹਮ ਚਰਣ ਸਰੇਵਹ ਖਿਨੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਪਗ ਧੋਵਹ ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਮੀਠ ਲਗਾਨ ਜੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: tinh ham charan sarevah khin khin pag dhovah jin har meeth lagaan jeeu ||
lines.translation: I bow at their feet; each and every moment, I wash the feet of those, unto whom the Lord seems sweet.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਮੀਠਾ ਲਾਇਆ ਪਰਮ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਇਆ ਮੁਖਿ ਭਾਗਾ ਰਤੀ ਚਾਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: har meethaa laaiaa param sukh paaiaa mukh bhaagaa ratee chaare ||
lines.translation: The Lord seems sweet to them, and they obtain the supreme status; their faces are radiant and beautiful with good fortune.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਗਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਹਾਰੁ ਉਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਾ ਕੰਠਿ ਧਾਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: guramat har gaaiaa har haar ur paaiaa har naamaa ka(n)th dhaare ||
lines.translation: Under Guru's Instruction, they sing the Lord's Name, and wear the garland of the Lord's Name around their necks; they keep the Lord's Name in their throats.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਏਕ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਸਮਤੁ ਕਰਿ ਦੇਖੈ ਸਭੁ ਆਤਮ ਰਾਮੁ ਪਛਾਨ ਜੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabh ek drisat samat kar dekhai sabh aatam raam pachhaan jeeu ||
lines.translation: They look upon all with equality, and recognize the Supreme Soul, the Lord, pervading among all.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਗਾਇਆ ਪਰਮ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਤੇ ਊਤਮ ਜਨ ਪਰਧਾਨ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: har har jas gaaiaa param pad paaiaa te ootam jan paradhaan jeeu ||2||
lines.translation: Those who sing the Praises of the Lord, Har, Har, obtain the supreme status; they are the most exalted and acclaimed people. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਈ ਹਰਿ ਰਸਨ ਰਸਾਈ ਵਿਚਿ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਹੋਇ ਜੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: satasa(n)gat man bhaaee har rasan rasaaee vich sa(n)gat har ras hoi jeeu ||
lines.translation: One whose mind is pleased with the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, savors the sublime essence of the Lord; in the Sangat, is this essence of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਆਰਾਧਿਆ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਵਿਗਾਸਿਆ ਬੀਜਾ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ਜੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: har har aaraadhiaa gur sabad vigaasiaa beejaa avar na koi jeeu ||
lines.translation: He meditates in adoration upon the Lord, Har, Har, and through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, he blossoms forth. He plants no other seed.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ਹਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਸੋਇ ਜਿਨਿ ਪੀਆ ਸੋ ਬਿਧਿ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: avar na koi har a(n)mrit soi jin peeaa so bidh jaanai ||
lines.translation: There is no Nectar, other than the Lord's Ambrosial Nectar. One who drinks it in, knows the way.

lines.gurmukhi: ਧਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਪੂਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਲਗਿ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: dhan dha(n)n guroo pooraa prabh paaiaa lag sa(n)gat naam pachhaanai ||
lines.translation: Hail, hail to the Perfect Guru; through Him, God is found. Joining the Sangat, the Naam is understood.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੋ ਸੇਵਿ ਨਾਮੋ ਆਰਾਧੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੈ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ਜੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: naamo sev naamo aaraadhai bin naamai avar na koi jeeu ||
lines.translation: I serve the Naam, and I meditate on the Naam. Without the Naam, there is no other at all.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਈ ਹਰਿ ਰਸਨ ਰਸਾਈ ਵਿਚਿ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਹੋਇ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: satasa(n)gat man bhaaee har rasan rasaaee vich sa(n)gat har ras hoi jeeu ||3||
lines.translation: One whose mind is pleased with the Sat Sangat, savors the sublime essence of the Lord; in the Sangat, is this essence of the Lord. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਦਇਆ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਧਾਰਹੁ ਪਾਖਣ ਹਮ ਤਾਰਹੁ ਕਢਿ ਲੇਵਹੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: har daiaa prabh dhaarahu paakhan ham taarahu kadh levahu sabad subhaai jeeu ||
lines.translation: O Lord God, shower Your Mercy upon me; I am just a stone. Please, carry me across, and lift me up with ease, through the Word of the Shabad.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੋਹ ਚੀਕੜਿ ਫਾਥੇ ਨਿਘਰਤ ਹਮ ਜਾਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਬਾਂਹ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਪਕਰਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: moh cheekaR phaathe nigharat ham jaate har baa(n)h prabhoo pakaraai jeeu ||
lines.translation: I am stuck in the swamp of emotional attachment, and I am sinking. O Lord God, please, take me by the arm.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਬਾਂਹ ਪਕਰਾਈ ਊਤਮ ਮਤਿ ਪਾਈ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣੀ ਜਨੁ ਲਾਗਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: prabh baa(n)h pakaraaee ootam mat paaee gur charanee jan laagaa ||
lines.translation: God took me by the arm, and I obtained the highest understanding; as His slave, I grasped the Guru's feet.
